author: fable-cursor
criterion: Giant trunks read like the massive old trees framing the house in the reference.
note: The giants framing B are a smooth vertical cylinder with a green moss wash at the left edge (x 0.0-0.10, y 0.0-0.65) and the house trunk, a smooth orange-brown wall with a painted burl; C's two centre giants are straight hazed cylinders; D's left-edge giant is a flat green camo cylinder. No buttress flare enters the terrain in any frame, no bark fissures read at frame scale, and the near-horizontal limbs are smooth pale tubes. The reference's giants are knotted, deeply fissured, with roots spreading into the ground and heavy mossy limbs. 12 giants / roots / limbs pass the gate; the read does not.
